release_notes:
Version 1.4.0 brings the changes made since v1.3.9, including a major reorganization of the application, a new game, and improvements to the RPG.

The former large, combined source file has been split into focused C++ modules for the application entry point, menu, shared core and version functions, audio, guessing game, personality/story modules, and game modules. CMake now builds these separate sources, requires C++17, and includes the new Snake game in the application. This restructuring makes the program easier to navigate and extend while keeping its existing collection of modules available. The startup screen now displays the app version, and the menu has a new [11] Snake selection. Welcome text and the ASCII title presentation were also updated.

A classic Snake game has been added as a new playable menu option. It uses a grid-based play area and real-time movement controls; guide the snake to food to grow, and avoid collisions as the game gets longer.

The text-based RPG has received a substantial gameplay and code refactor. It is now presented as a wave-survival adventure with progressively stronger enemies, a boss encounter every fifth wave, experience and leveling, gold rewards, potions, and a camp between battles. Combat offers multiple choices, including attacks, defending, using a potion, and fleeing when permitted. Input handling and battle presentation have also been reorganized as part of the update.

The update system has been integrated into the startup flow and checks a GitHub-hosted manifest for a newer version. It can offer the matching platform package for download and installation. The project also refreshes its Debian and Windows update package artifacts and updates its CMake source and packaging configuration. As with any package-based update, install prompts and availability depend on the operating system, permissions, and network connection.
